look_here_first: Find the slender nearly linear inferior ovary and capsule, with narrow upper leaves/bracts and small open flowers high on the spike-like shoot. Photograph pod with ruler before separating from coloradoensis.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Small annual herb of the bellflower family; plant form and flowering-stem architecture help preliminary identification.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Simple alternate leaves; upper leaves/narrow bracts dominate flowering portion; lower foliage broader.

key_traits.label: Flower
key_traits.text: Individual five-lobed usually blue-violet fused corolla at a stem leaf axil; upper open and lower closed flowers may coexist.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: Long very narrow seed capsule below calyx; dimensions and dehiscence pore need species-matched macro.

key_traits.label: Stem
key_traits.text: Alternate leafy annual stem with calyx and flower parts above an inferior ovary.
